{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Com 1''''' was a [[Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle]] used by [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces lead by [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Vader]] were tasked with capturing 3 [[Muurian transport]]s ''[[Botani]]''. [[Tan (title)|Tan]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] leading an [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboat]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] while '''Com 1''' was to be captured under orders from the [[Prophets of the Dark Side|Secret Order of the Empire]]. The shuttle attempted to flee, but along with the transports was disabled and captured.
